name: economic-to-business-central
title: e-conomic → Business Central migration
tldr: Migrates a Danish e-conomic bookkeeping into a Business Central company through the Origo Cloud Events connector — chart of accounts, posting setup, VAT, customers, items, transactions, sales invoices and bilag receipts — reconciling to the source exactly, with two PowerShell helpers for the receipt (bilag) side.

businessCentral.notes: A company with no posted entries. Use a sandbox first, always.

apps.name: Origo Cloud Events Core
apps.notes: MCP connector, connected and authenticated to your BC tenant. The ChangeLog Write Guard must be opened before you start and restored afterwards.

tools: PowerShell 7+ (only for the bilag receipt scripts)
Entra ID app registration with API.ReadWrite.All (only for uploading receipts)
